lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repeating sequence of vertically aligned columns containing 3 to 5 high-luminance circular spots, extending from the posterior gill region across the mid-flank toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to create a structured rectilinear grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high luminance on the superior side and deep shadowing on the inferior side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or irregular indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin near its apex.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'U-shaped' or looped arrangement of spots and high-intensity lines is visible on the upper flank immediately posterior to the gill slits.
